Thanks all — good sync this morning. Quick consolidated follow-ups so we have a single source of truth heading into QBR prep. Action items below; I’ve flagged the exec asks (red) and procurement/contract checkpoints (amber).

Top asks (please confirm owners / ETA by EOD Wednesday):
- Exec ask: final list of 3 priority customer narratives for QBR (owner: lauren_bishop) — ETA: Thu 08/27
- Roadmap ask: decide on pinning model-variant rollout window for Dedicated customers (owner: vivek_kulkarni) — ETA: Mon 08/30
- Procurement: finalize SOW and billing cadence for Acme pilot (owner: Megan / procurement@acme-analytics.com) — ETA: Fri 09/03

Attached: qbr_action_matrix.csv (current action register), roadmap-v2.pdf (highlighted slides we referenced). I’ve also put a short checklist in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AqQBROnramp-plan

Please reply inline for any changes. If you need me to escalate any of these to execs before the QBR dry run, call it out and I’ll surface.

Thanks — Karthik

Appreciate the clear summary. A couple quick clarifications from Acme side before procurement moves forward: 

- On the SOW: we need an explicit SLA table (uptime, latency p95 targets) in the SOW appendix. Can you provide the SLA table you shared during the call?
- Billing cadence: Acme prefers net-45 for pilots > $50k. Is that acceptable?
- Mutual action plan: Can we have a single line-item that maps Redwood owner -> Acme counterpart for each action in the matrix? Our procurement team finds that easier to track when we sign.

Also — timeline pressure: our internal QBR with the executive board is 09/10. We’d like the pilot contract fully in place a week prior (09/03) so we have time for legal review.

Megan

- SLA appendix: attached (excerpted table included in roadmap-v2.pdf). Vivek, please confirm the p95 latency target for Dedicated (current suggestion: 120ms p95 for short-context workload). If that needs to change we should flag to legal now.
- Billing cadence: Acme net-45 is acceptable for pilot D-1437, finance has approved contingent on the signed SOW. Marissa — please confirm invoicing contact and finalize billing terms in SOW.
- Mutual action plan: I’ve added a column to the matrix mapping Redwood owner -> Acme counterpart and a HubSpot link for deal tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1437

Exec asks (marked in the matrix):
1) Three priority narratives: Lauren to produce slides by Thu 08/27 morning (Lauren — see comments I added in Drive).
2) Risk callouts: we’ll surface fallback model variants and rollback plan in the QBR appendix (owner: vivek_kulkarni).

Next steps:
- Lauren: slide drafts (Thu 08/27 morning)
- Vivek: confirm p95 and rollback variant (Mon 08/30)
- Marissa: confirm invoice contact & SOW wording for net-45 (Mon 08/30)
- Megan / Acme procurement: sign by Fri 09/03 to meet your internal board timeline

If any of these are slipping, say so ASAP and I’ll schedule a short escalation call with execs.

Best — Karthik
